scientific_role: Evaluate the already-frozen I1-M0 method along two complementary result axes without changing I1, A_i, M0, or the Phase-1 benchmark.

current_benchmark_measure.rationale: All current frozen A_G comparisons use the same Q>=0.5 threshold. The common Q extent therefore cancels exactly from intersection-over-union, avoiding an arbitrary finite Q ceiling.
current_benchmark_measure.future_unequal_quality_rule: If q_min differs, an explicit finite quality_upper evaluation domain is required before computing 3-D Jaccard.

region_evaluation.containment: Retain containment/applicability as a coarse relation, but do not use it as the sole region-quality result.

rho_vector_sensitivity.support: Cartesian product R^3 of rho values already exposed by the three hash-frozen public I1 cards
rho_vector_sensitivity.off_diagonal: diagnostic sensitivity only; not a prediction for a common global rho_G
